form.label: Dell PowerStore remote logging - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed onboarding and first-triage dashboard for Dell PowerStore remote logging structured-data smoke events. This is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") severity IN (MAJOR,CRITICAL,Critical,Major) | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") alert_raised=true | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") event_code=0x0240010* | stats count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | timechart count
index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count by severity | sort -count

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count, values(severity) as severities, values(alert_raised) as alert_raised, values(call_home) as call_home, values(kb_article) as kb_articles by event_type, event_code | sort -count | head 50

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | table _time host source event_code severity event_type alert_raised call_home kb_article message marker | sort -_time | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | stats count, dc(event_code) as event_codes, values(severity) as severities, values(vendor_product) as vendor_product by host, source, sourcetype | sort -count | head 100

index=infraops sourcetype="dell:emc:powerstore" host=$host_tok$ (severity="$severity_tok$" OR "$severity_tok$"="*") | table _time host source sourcetype vendor product event_code severity event_type alert_raised call_home kb_article action signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100
